title: "Presentation Hub"
subtitle: "Curated Slide Decks, Portfolios, and Research Summaries"
page-layout: full
listing:
  contents: decks # Directs Quarto to look inside the slides/ folder
  type: grid      # Changes display style to a modern card grid
  sort: "date desc" # Shows newest decks first
  categories: true # Enables clickable filter tags on the right sidebar
  sort-ui: true    # Gives users a dropdown to sort by date/title
  filter-ui: true  # Adds a live search bar above your grid
  fields: [image, date, title, subtitle, author, categories]
---

Welcome to the repository for our presentation decks. Use the search bar or the category sidebar below to filter through the topics.
